name: Six Senses Kanuhura
positioning: Maldives island resort of beach and overwater pool villas spread across three private islands in the Lhaviyani Atoll
best_for: Families and groups wanting multi-bedroom villas on the beach or over the water
Divers, snorkelers and travelers interested in marine conservation

facts.text: The resort is in the Lhaviyani Atoll.
The atoll is surrounded by turquoise waters, vibrant reefs and white beaches.
The resort is a 40-minute seaplane ride from Male International Airport, or reached by speedboat transfer.
Villas range from one to three bedrooms, suiting couples, families and larger groups.
Multi-bedroom villas are available both on the beach and over the water.
Diving is offered at sites around Lhaviyani.
Watersports include paddling and sailing, with activities in, on or under the sea.
At the Earth Lab, guests turn everyday waste into something useful through workshops.
Sustainability Tours showcase the water bottling plant, Organic Garden and Orchid Garden.
A castaway lunch island is a boat ride away, and a third island is left entirely to nature.

highlights.text: The resort encompasses three private islands.
Guests can have a castaway experience on two deserted islands just off Kanuhura.
Accommodation is beach, family and overwater pool villas, with the lagoon at your feet.
A Marine Biology team monitors and protects turtles, coral and seagrass across the atoll year-round, sharing progress through talks and in-water experiences.

considerations.text: Arrival is by a 40-minute seaplane ride from Male International Airport or by speedboat transfer.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive island experience.
